string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: NEW: A short first-run walkthrough shows how the app is laid out — no permission prompts, just the tour
Smoother throughout: staggered card entrances, tactile press feedback, and animated loading-to-content transitions across the whole toolset
A livelier bottom bar — the selected tab now eases into place instead of snapping
A softer handoff from the launch splash screen into the app
Fixed a formatting bug where long button labels (like "Uninstall") could break into single characters on narrow cards
